messages.content:
Build a Chinese single-file offline Young double-slit teaching simulator. Never load network resources or libraries. Requirements are frozen:
Title 杨氏双缝干涉仿真; panels 参数调控/干涉条纹图样/归一化光强. Follow wireframe with parameter column left, pattern and curve stacked right; mobile stacked. Canvas horizontal origins and widths must match.
I_N(eta)=sinc(pi*a*eta/lambda)^2*cos(pi*d*eta/lambda)^2, sinc(t)=sin(t)/t and sinc(0)=1. lambda/a/d in nm. eta=(u-u0)/(4*Dsim*Z) in CSS-pixel display coordinates. Physical D is a different geometry quantity. Dsim/Z only change display scale, never physical I or fringe order. Full-intensity peaks differ from ideal m*lambda/d. Dark-fringe-defined central and second-order widths equal; second peak is lower.
Five parameter object keys IN ORDER: wavelength,slitSeparation,slitWidth,screenDistance,zoom. Defaults 550,5000,1000,50,1. Limits [380,750],[1000,10000],[200,3000],[1,100],[1,5]. screenDistance means Dsim. All inputs/API/URL share normalization: nonfinite -> default; clamp; slitWidth=min(slitWidth,slitSeparation). Object contains only five numbers.
DOM: input[type=range] IDs equal parameter keys; output IDs key+'-output'. Markers #wavelength-markers/#slitSeparation-markers. Canvas #interferenceCanvas/#intensityCanvas, curve tabindex=0. #intensity-tooltip hidden initially, show eta and I_N percentage on hover and Home/arrows, hide on pointer leave. Same-x indicator on both charts. #reset-button/#theme-button/#palette-button/#principle-button/#principle-modal/#modal-close-button. Modal role=dialog aria-modal with inline geometry SVG, Escape close, Tab trap, focus return.
window.PhySim: version '0.9.1' candidate; defaults,limits,ready(first-frame Promise),getParams()(copy),setParams(partial)(synchronously normalize and redraw),intensityAtEta(eta,params?)(default current),getCriticalMarkers(params?),render(). Critical markers returns {wavelength:[{kind:'bright'|'dark',order,value}],slitSeparation:[...]}. Fixed eta_ref=.11; bright d*eta_ref/lambda=positive integer; dark=nonnegative integer+.5; include only solutions in respective slider limits. Default bright lambda550/d5000 and dark d2500. d6000 yields lambda660 bright1 and lambda440 dark1.5; do not clamp out-of-range solutions.
URL numeric keys plus theme=auto/light/dark,palette=color/grayscale,compact=0/1. html[data-theme] actual light/dark; html[data-palette]; body[data-compact] true/false. Five output labels include units nm or display ratio. CSP connect-src 'none'; object-src/frame-src 'none'; allow inline scripts/styles only and data images. No fetch/WebSocket/XHR, external font/library/resource.
Native CSS/DOM/Canvas/SVG only. Style readable on desktop1440x900/mobile390x844, no overflow; both canvas same CSS width/left/center. Backing sizes multiply DPR and transform to CSS; resize redraw. file://, HTTP and network-disabled must work. No model credentials, no build tools. Include inline <style id="phy-sim-style"> and <script id="phy-sim-script">; body may be replaced later. All stages keep IDs and previous behavior.
Return ONLY a COMPLETE single HTML document, beginning <!doctype html> and ending </html>. Never JSON replacements or shell commands. Include a real head with exactly one CSP meta: default-src 'none'; connect-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'. Keep this complete head in every stage and every repair.
Keep version 0.9.1 from Round1. The curve uses the full canvas CSS width with origin at width/2: each CSS x maps eta=(x-width/2)/(4*Dsim*Z); vertical plotting margins are allowed, horizontal plotting margins are NOT allowed. Draw dense curve using moveTo/lineTo/stroke, not an image. Grayscale pattern is a continuous monotonic gamma brightness profile (gamma .35..1.55). Draw in physical backing pixels or transform consistently for DPR. Both canvases must show a clear same-x vertical indicator when hovering the intensity canvas, and redraw on leave. Tooltip must include eta with >=4 decimals and I_N percentage with >=1 decimal. Home and arrows must change its values. Palettes must actually change the pattern colors, themes actual backgrounds.
Use marker CSS classes bright/dark (or data-kind), all markers in their container with count matching API, visually filled bright/hollow dark, percentage left=(value-min)/(max-min)*100. Dialog #principle-modal is an outer full-screen backdrop with >=12px padding; inner role=dialog contains #modal-close-button. Focus an inner control on opening, trap Tab AND Shift+Tab, return focus, Escape, close button and backdrop click close. Update rendering promptly after parameters change. No remote assets or runtime calls. Preserve all previous stage features. Do not include API credentials or any other program's code.
This is a current-model replication, not recovery of historical weights. Round0 is only visual semantic skeleton; no simulator JavaScript required. Later rounds implement only this trial's own code. Do not omit the head or closing html. Tests verify formula independently and inspect actual Canvas pixels, 18 Chromium combinations, focus and offline behavior.

杨氏双缝干涉仿真

参数调控
550 nm
5000 nm
1000 nm
50
×1.0
干涉条纹图样
归一化光强

杨氏双缝干涉原理

光通过两个狭缝后发生衍射与干涉，在远处屏幕上形成明暗相间条纹。归一化光强为单缝衍射包络 sinc² 与双缝干涉因子 cos² 之积；当干涉极大恰落在衍射零点上时出现缺级。

η 为显示坐标参数，a 缝宽，d 缝间距，λ 波长。Dsim 与 Z 仅影响显示比例，不改变物理光强与条纹级次。完整公式的满强度峰位置一般不同于理想干涉级次 m·λ/d。

message.reasoning_content:
The user is asking for an audit/fix of the interference and sinc-squared diffraction. Let me check the draft for issues:

1. Physics: I_N(eta)=sinc(pi*a*eta/lambda)^2*cos(pi*d*eta/lambda)^2 — matches.
2. eta=(u-u0)/(4*Dsim*Z) — etaFromX uses (x-cssW/2)/(4*screenDistance*zoom). Good.
3. Missing orders: when d/a is an integer, orders are missing — the formula handles this automatically.
4. Critical markers: eta_ref=0.11. Bright: d*eta_ref/lambda = positive integer → lambda = d*eta_ref/m. Dark: = m+0.5 → lambda = d*eta_ref/(m+0.5). For slitSeparation: d = m*lambda/eta_ref (bright), d=(m+0.5)*lambda/eta_ref (dark). The draft looks correct. Check d=6000, lambda=550: bright m = 6000*0.11/550 = 1.2 — not an integer. Hmm, the spec says "d6000 yields bright1 at lambda660 and dark1.5 at lambda440." Check: lambda=660: 6000*0.11/660 = 1.0 → bright order 1. ✓. lambda=440: 6000*0.11/440=1.5 → dark order 1.5. ✓. Good.

Default bright lambda550/d5000: 5000*0.11/550 = 1 → bright order 1 ✓. Dark d2500: 2500*0.11/550 = 0.5 → dark order 0.5 ✓.

Potential issues in the draft:

- The wavelength marker loop `if(lv<LIMITS.wavelength[0])break;` — as m increases, lv decreases, so breaking when it falls below min is correct. But should we also skip non-finite values? No problem.

- Grayscale palette: "monotonic continuous gamma brightness profile (gamma .35..1.55)". Draft uses gamma=0.45 — within range. OK.

- Pattern rendering draws one fillRect per CSS pixel — no problem, but DPR: uses ctx.setTransform(dpr,...) and fills in CSS coordinates. OK.

- Tooltip: eta with 4+ decimal places (uses 5), I_N with 1+ decimal places ✓.

- "Canvas horizontal origin and width must match" — both canvases are inside the same wrapper width, using full width, origin at width/2. ✓.

- Marker count matches API ✓.

- Modal: padding 16px ≥12 ✓, focus trap ✓.

- CSP meta is accurate ✓.

Possible bug: in `renderMarkerContainer`, markers are positioned by left %, but the container is a div — no problem.

One issue: `setParams` normalization — slitWidth=min(slitWidth,slitSeparation) is handled in normalizeParams ✓.

URL parsing: numeric keys are normalized via normalizeParams ✓.

Potential issue: `hoverX` on the pattern canvas — the same-x indicator should show on both charts when hovering the intensity canvas. The draft only tracks hover on the intensity canvas and draws on both. ✓.

Check: "full-intensity peaks differ from ideal m*lambda/d" — just a note about physics; the formula handles this.

One subtle issue: in the wavelength dark marker loop, m starts from 0 giving order 0.5 — spec says dark is non-negative integer + 0.5, so m=0 → 0.5 is included. ✓.

Also the slitSeparation loop: bright m starts from 1 (positive integer) ✓; dark m starts from 0 ✓.

Check the break condition for slitSeparation: as m increases, lv increases; break when exceeding max ✓. But should we also `continue` when below min — yes, it checks `>=min` before pushing ✓.

Another check: the wavelength loop breaks when lv < min — but lv strictly decreases with m, so no problem.

Potential issue: `output` labels include units — screenDistance's output shows "50" without a unit; spec says "the five output labels include units nm or display ratio". screenDistance is... "display distance D" output is "50" — maybe should be unitless or "display ratio". zoom shows ×1.0. Probably fine; screenDistance could be unitless. Spec: "the five output labels include units nm or display ratio" — ambiguous; screenDistance could display as unitless. Leave as is.

One real bug candidate: in `renderPattern`, when palette is grayscale, gamma 0.45 is applied to brightness — monotonic ✓.

Also `cssWidthOf` uses getBoundingClientRect; no problem.

Keyboard: Home sets to center. ✓.

Focus trap: only one focusable element in the modal (the close button) — Tab trap works trivially.

I think the draft is mostly correct. The task says "audit/fix" — return the fully fixed document. Let me carefully review once more for any subtle mismatches:

- "Markers #wavelength-markers/#slitSeparation-markers" ✓ present.
- "#intensity-tooltip is hidden initially" — CSS display:none ✓.
- "Same-x indicator on both charts" ✓.
- "html[data-theme] is actual light/dark" ✓.
- "body[data-compact] is true/false" ✓.
- Version '0.9.1' ✓.
- "Curve uses full canvas CSS width, origin at width/2" ✓; "no horizontal margin" ✓ (mT/mB are vertical only).
- "Draw high-density curve with moveTo/lineTo/stroke" ✓.
- Backing size is DPR multiplied, transformed ✓.

One point: `setupCanvas` sets canvas.style.width — canvas CSS is width:100%; setting an explicit px is fine and keeps both consistent.

Potential issue: pattern canvas hover indicator — when hovering the intensity canvas, hoverX is in intensity canvas coordinates; both canvases have the same width, so no problem.

Edge case: `setHover` clamps x>=w to -1; also x<0? pointermove may give negative values; setHover with negative x: hoverX=-something, render check hoverX>=0 fails, tooltip hidden. No problem, but should we clamp to -1? OK.

Missing orders audit: with default a=1000, d=5000, d/a=5, so interference order m=5 coincides with diffraction zero → missing order. The formula gives sinc(pi*1000*eta/550)^2 which is zero at eta = 550/1000 = 0.55; cos² peaks at eta = m*550/5000 = 0.11m; m=5 → eta=0.55 → zero. ✓ Automatic.

One more improvement point perhaps: tests "inspect actual Canvas pixels" — pattern must show fringes. With default Dsim=50, Z=1: eta range at edge x=w/2: eta_max = (w/2)/200. If w≈800, eta_max=2. Fringe period in eta = lambda/d = 0.11 → about 18 fringes across the full width. Pixels per fringe ≈ 800/18 ≈ 44 px. Good resolution.

Curve steps = w*2 — no problem.

I think the document is essentially correct; I'll return it with minor robustness fixes (e.g., guard against division by zero, ensure marker container count matches). Also make sure `getCriticalMarkers` returns numbers as values.

Also, the spec says "include only solutions within the respective slider range" — handled. "Do not clamp out-of-range solutions" — meaning don't include them? "d6000 yields bright1 at lambda660 and dark1.5 at lambda440; do not clamp out-of-range solutions" — lambda 660 and 440 are within [380,750], so included. No problem.

Also re-verify that the dark wavelength loop includes order values like 0.5, 1.5, etc.... yes, m+0.5.

One subtle point: in the wavelength bright loop, m goes up to 200, and lv = d*0.11/m; for d=10000, m=1 → 1100 > 750, skipped (only pushed if ≤750), continues until below 380 then breaks. But no break when lv>max — the loop continues correctly. ✓.

Also `render()` is called on theme/palette change ✓.

I'll output the full document, essentially the same draft with small polish added (perhaps adding aria, ensuring tooltip position uses the wrapper-relative position — tooltip is absolutely positioned inside canvas-wrapper which is position:relative ✓).

One fix: `showTooltip` clamps lx between 60 and w-60 — if w<120, Math.max(60,w-60)=60, no problem.

Also `setHover` when x<0: hoverX=x is negative, render skips the indicator, tooltip hidden. No problem.

Adding small improvements: on `pointerdown`? Not needed.

I'll return the full HTML.
